content_sections.heading: Zilla Parishad Chandrapur Nutritionist Job Description
content_sections.text: Strengthening mother and child health services at the Nutrition Rehabilitation Center (NRC) located at Sub-District Hospital Warora and Rural Hospital Rajura.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary contract basis Service can be terminated immediately without prior notice

content_sections.text: Scrutiny of received applications Publication of eligible and ineligible candidate lists Application scrutiny followed by publication of list of eligible candidates on the website

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Final year marksheet of required educational qualification Experience certificates Valid council registration certificate if technical post Domicile certificate / Residence certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Zilla Parishad Chandrapur Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the application format from the website https://zpchandrapur.maharashtra.gov.in. Fill out the application completely on A4 size white paper in neat handwriting. Attach self-attested copies of required documents and final year marksheets. Send the sealed envelope containing the application by post or in person to Health Department, Zilla Parishad, Chandrapur on or before 06/11/2026 up to 4:00 PM.
